base: relative flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-accent-subtle p-6

slots.kicker: inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-fg-secondary
slots.title: text-xl font-medium tracking-tight text-fg
slots.sheet: -mx-6 -mb-6 mt-auto flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-t-lg bg-surface p-6
slots.count: inline-flex h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-neutral-bg px-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-neutral-fg tabular-nums
slots.recentItem: flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-divider py-3 first:pt-0 last:border-b-0
slots.recentTitle: truncate rounded-xs text-sm font-medium text-fg hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
slots.undo: flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md bg-surface px-4 py-3
